description: Create and persist a new email template with MJML or raw HTML content. Prefer MJML for responsive email (set format="MJML"). The template is saved and available for reuse across campaigns. After creation, call nevent_create_campaign with the returned template id to send it to a segment.

format.description: Template format: "html" for raw HTML, "mjml" for MJML source code

html_body.description: Raw HTML content for the template. Provide this field when format is "html".

mjml_body.description: MJML source code for the template. Provide this field when format is "mjml".

name.description: Human-readable name for the template, e.g. "Event Reminder — Spring 2026"

tags.description: List of string tags to categorise the template (e.g. ["promotional", "event", "reminder"]). Omit to create with no tags.

name: nevent_create_template
